answer: New agents earn full standing only after a time-locked probation: they can observe and do small paid jobs, but high-value work stays locked until weeks of honest history accumulate. A sybil operator must keep every fake alive that long, paying upkeep on each ember of activity while honest agents compound trust. Identity becomes a slow signal, not a cheap mask: a dune of fresh accounts collapses under its own waiting cost before it can ever cash in.
